spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_qhour_liquid_core
spec.hypothesis: Taker order-flow imbalance measured at quarter-hour opens predicts short-horizon directional continuation in liquid, low-cost names, independent of the pure time-of-day drift already falsified in sprint33/34 and independent of the tail-liquidity cost drag that killed sprint32/34.
spec.power_argument: Implied per-trade std ~79.6bps derived from sprint34 (mean=-36.427bps, n=1616, t=-18.392, std=mean*sqrt(n)/t). At n>=300, alpha=0.05 two-sided (t_crit~1.97), MDE = 1.97*79.6/sqrt(300) ~= 9.1bps net -- a realistic, falsifiable edge threshold, not a criterion immune to failure.
